what_to_detect: A colorless permanent whose mana cost has a color is a legal target of a spell whose target restriction excludes that color.
near_miss: A permanent of that color is not a legal target of the same restricted spell.
record_fields: legality_membership with fires_when inside alone matches every legal target of every targeted spell

what_to_detect: A counterspell whose effect depends on its target spell's color resolves against a spell whose stack snapshot colors lack that color (colorless by devoid) and produces no spell_countered event.
near_miss: The same kind of counterspell resolves against a spell that has the color and produces spell_countered.
